character: A small woman of forty, freckled, grey at the temples, deep laugh lines. A wide, animated face, mid-story, eyebrows high.
wardrobe: A long patched coat sewn all over with coins from many lands, polished silver-buckled shoes.

full.framing: Full body portrait, front view. Standing on a tavern table, arms flung wide.

portrait.framing: Head and shoulders portrait, square crop, filling the frame, facing the viewer.

scene.framing: Telling a story from a tabletop in a crowded lantern-lit tavern built inside the hull of a ship, the audience leaning in.
